question: In the passage, what is the closest meaning of the word "superseded"?
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Replaced.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"superseded"** means to take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use); to replace. (प्रतिस्थापित करना, स्थान लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** The old law was superseded by a new and more effective one.
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, "superseded" means that something new has taken the place of something old. The closest meaning to "superseded" is therefore "replaced."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Replaced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Upgraded **(उन्नत किया गया): Raised to a higher standard, improved.

 
 
• **Example:** The software was upgraded to include new features.
 
 
 
• **Abandoned **(छोड़ दिया गया): Left behind or deserted.
 
 
• **Example:** The old factory was abandoned and left to decay.
 
 
 
• **Destroyed **(नष्ट किया गया): Put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it.
 
 
• **Example:** The hurricane destroyed many homes along the coast.
